description.short: Ten PM specialists in the channel where your team already works.
description.full: Tarteeb routes a plain-language project question to whichever of its ten specialist agents apply - critical path, earned value, business case, estimating, scope and decision analysis. Deterministic engines do every calculation; a single brief comes back with Approve, Discuss and Reject, and every step is written to an append-only audit trail. The AI advises; a human decides.

commands.title: critical path
commands.description: When does the project finish and where is the slack?

commands.title: budget check
commands.description: How are we tracking on cost and schedule? (PV, EV, AC, BAC)

commands.title: business case
commands.description: NPV, ROI and payback from yearly costs and benefits

commands.title: scope check
commands.description: Has the work breakdown grown since baseline?
